content.logline: Desperate to save an allied stronghold, a battle-hardened Three Kingdoms general must lead his exhausted troops across a deadly, freezing mountain pass before the enemy breaches the city gates.

scene_outline.conflict: Captain Shen points out that the sheer ice cliffs will mean heavy casualties before they even see a battle.
scene_outline.goal: Commit the army to the deadly mountain route.
scene_outline.turn: Liang Ping delivers a rallying decree, choosing the risk of the mountain over the certainty of their comrades' slaughter.

scene_outline.conflict: The cold and exhaustion threaten a mutiny as progress grinds to a complete halt in the snowdrifts.
scene_outline.goal: Survive the peak of the mountain during a violent, freezing gale.
scene_outline.turn: Liang Ping sacrifices his own horse and cold-weather gear to clear a path, shaming and inspiring his men into a renewed, desperate push.

scene_outline.conflict: The exhausted Shu forces must plunge down the scree slopes directly into an entrenched enemy formation.
scene_outline.goal: Break the enemy siege lines from the mountain descent.
scene_outline.turn: The surprise vanguard charge triggers a chaotic rout among the enemy ranks, turning a suicidal descent into a legendary victory.

story_arc.conflict: The army is already exhausted, and the pass is considered impassable even in good weather.
story_arc.summary: With all main roads blocked by enemy forces, General Liang Ping realizes the only way to save the besieged fortress in time is to march his army over the lethal, unmapped Dragon's Spine Pass.
story_arc.turning_point: Liang Ping orders the march up the mountain, effectively burning their figurative bridges—there is no turning back.

story_arc.conflict: Nature itself is destroying the army, pitting Liang Ping's relentless drive against his men's survival limit.
story_arc.summary: High in the mountains, a brutal blizzard halts the army's progress. Men begin to freeze and collapse, prompting Captain Shen to plead for a retreat.
story_arc.turning_point: Liang Ping strips off his heavy commander's armor and leads from the front, manually pulling supply carts through the snow to inspire the troops to keep moving.

story_arc.conflict: The attacking soldiers are half-frozen and starving, facing a well-rested and vastly larger besieging force.
story_arc.summary: The surviving troops reach the summit and charge down the mountain slopes, crashing into the rear of the enemy siege camp with unstoppable momentum.
story_arc.turning_point: The sheer shock and ferocious momentum of an army descending from an 'impossible' flank shatters enemy morale, breaking the siege.

content.logline: Desperate to save a besieged allied fortress, a battle-hardened Three Kingdoms general must lead his exhausted troops through a deadly, blizzard-swept mountain pass before time runs out.

scene_outline.conflict: The looming, imposing mountains and biting cold make the soldiers hesitate, fearing a frozen death.
scene_outline.goal: To convince the weary army to enter the deadly mountain pass.
scene_outline.turn: Gao leads by example, marching into the snowdrift first and demanding nothing of his men he won't endure himself.

scene_outline.conflict: Nature's wrath batters the column, and the icy footing causes a soldier to slip toward the abyss.
scene_outline.goal: To safely cross a shattered section of the trail during a blinding blizzard.
scene_outline.turn: Gao leaps to catch the falling soldier, demonstrating that they will survive or perish together as a unit.

scene_outline.conflict: The men are at their physical limits, and the enemy army below is vast and heavily armored.
scene_outline.goal: To strike the enemy siege camp before the allied fortress falls.
scene_outline.turn: Gao draws his blade and signals the charge; the momentum of their downhill assault completely overwhelms the unprepared siege forces.

story_arc.conflict: The men are exhausted and terrified of the deadly weather conditions on the peaks.
story_arc.summary: General Gao and his troops reach the base of the treacherous mountains, realizing it is the only route that will allow them to reach the fortress in time.
story_arc.turning_point: Gao dismounts his horse and takes the first step onto the frozen path on foot, inspiring his men to follow.

story_arc.conflict: The howling mountain wind threatens to blow the soldiers off the ledge, eroding their remaining morale and physical strength.

story_arc.turning_point: When a soldier slips over the edge, Gao risks his own life to haul him back up, forging an unbreakable bond among the survivors.

story_arc.summary: The battered army reaches the summit just as the enemy forces breach the outer walls of the valley fortress below.

locations.description: A vertical, ice-slicked mountain cliff face battered by howling winds. It is considered entirely impassable by military forces.
locations.name: Black Ridge Pass

locations.description: A massive, heavily fortified enemy encampment situated at the base of the mountain, heavily guarding the front but leaving the rear cliff-face exposed.

content.logline: A desperate Three Kingdoms general leads his exhausted infantry on a perilous hand-over-hand mountain climb to launch a devastating surprise foot-assault and break a deadly siege.

scene_outline.conflict: Lieutenant Wei argues that the men will freeze or fall, insisting they take the long route, which will be too late.
scene_outline.goal: Zhao must convince his exhausted soldiers to abandon their horses and climb the vertical cliff.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao strips off his heavy commander's mantle and begins climbing the ice-slicked rock solo, forcing his men's loyalty to overcome their fear.

scene_outline.conflict: A jagged rock slices a primary climbing rope; Wei and several soldiers slip, dangling precariously over the abyss.
scene_outline.goal: The vanguard must survive the treacherous hand-over-hand ascent through howling winds.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao wedges himself into a crevice and grabs the fraying rope bare-handed, enduring immense pain to pull his lieutenant up over the ledge.

scene_outline.conflict: They have no cavalry, no heavy armor, and are facing a massive army; they must rely entirely on shock and hand-to-hand savagery.
scene_outline.goal: Break the enemy siege by attacking the camp's vulnerable rear.
scene_outline.turn: Zhao leads a screaming infantry charge out of the mountain fog, tossing torches into the enemy tents; the enemy panics at the impossible ambush and the siege lines collapse.

story_arc.conflict: The men are exhausted, and scaling the mountain without gear seems like a suicide mission.
story_arc.summary: General Zhao halts his vanguard at the base of Black Ridge Pass, realizing the only way to reach the besieged city in time is to leave their horses behind and climb the sheer cliffs on foot.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao abandons his own armor and mount, striking the rock face bare-handed to lead by example.

story_arc.conflict: Gravity, freezing temperatures, and failing equipment threaten to wipe out the vanguard before they ever see battle.
story_arc.summary: Mid-climb, the howling mountain winds and ice test the infantry's limits; a frayed rope snaps, nearly sending a dozen men to their deaths.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao catches the falling lifeline, his hands bleeding against the stone, holding the weight long enough for the men to secure a new hold.

story_arc.conflict: Zhao's men are vastly outnumbered and fighting strictly on foot against an entrenched, armored enemy.
story_arc.summary: Surviving the descent, Zhao's infantry emerges from the shadows of the cliff and launches a brutal, silent foot-assault on the unguarded rear of the siege camp.
story_arc.turning_point: The sheer shock of heavily armed infantry emerging from an 'impassable' mountain throws the enemy camp into a total, chaotic rout, breaking the siege.
